A1.justification: Both PDFs describe T-JEPA and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–H. All 26 pages in each version support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original T-JEPA downstream experiments, representation analyses and regularization-token ablations, including Table 1 and Figures 2–5.

after.justification: v3 retains the original downstream experiments, representation analyses and regularization-token ablations reported in v2.

M1.justification: The encoders, EMA updates, masking procedure, transformer predictor, loss, regularization tokens and downstream projections are unchanged in Section 3 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both retain Adult, Higgs, Helena, Jannis, ALOI, California housing and tabular MNIST, plus ImageNet-1K for the I-JEPA training-regime comparison. No dataset or test scenario is added.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Tables 1–2 and the feature-importance analysis is unchanged. The newly cited Sui et al. method is discussed only as related work, without evaluated results.

E3.justification: Both specify the same 80/10/10 splits, preprocessing, accuracy/RMSE metrics, validation-based tuning and model settings. The 50,000-sample representation analyses and batch-size-16 I-JEPA experiment also remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The representation-space analyses, regularization-token ablation, feature-importance comparisons and unsuccessful alternative masking/predictor designs are retained unchanged in Section 5 and Appendices D–E.

E5.justification: The stated 20-run mean/standard-deviation reporting, missing SwitchTab uncertainties and Kendall correlation significance reporting are unchanged. No new seed, confidence-interval or statistical-estimation information appears.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 and the plotted analyses retain their results. For example, Table 2 still reports average ranks of 2.6 for ResNet+T-JEPA and 3.9 for MLP+T-JEPA. Appendix runtimes and alternative-design findings also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations retain their substance. Appendix H changes REG to [REG] in a concatenation expression, standardizing notation without changing the operation or mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about augmentation-free tabular learning, downstream performance, identification of relevant features and regularization tokens.

C2.justification: Interpretations of representation collapse, feature importance and downstream performance remain unchanged. Section 6 retains the same architectural applicability limitations and proposed future investigations.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 changes the stated code source from online GitHub code to supplementary material. The appendix repository link and Appendix F's GitHub statement remain, so this does not establish lost repository access. Implementation and hardware details are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Sui et al. (2024) and briefly describes its augmentation-free random-projector approach. It removes the explicit contrast between T-JEPA's non-contrastive objective and SubTab's contrastive regularization, retaining their data-space versus latent-space distinction.

P1.justification: v3 updates the publication header, makes localized related-work and code-access edits, spells out several equation references, standardizes [REG] notation and corrects a bibliography name. Section and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1 and 7 receive minor caption edits to equation references, accompanied by limited text reflow and spacing changes. All seven figures and eighteen tables retain their substantive displays, structure and numbering.

improvement.justification: v3 fills a limited prior-work gap by acknowledging Sui et al.'s relevant augmentation-free approach and makes token notation more consistent. The SubTab discussion loses its contrastive-loss distinction but retains the principal reconstruction-space comparison. The net gain is modest scholarly completeness and clarity; the scientific evidence and appendix repository link are unchanged.
